notes.title: OlliOlli World Update 1.0.2 - Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]OlliOlli World Update 1.0.2 - Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

Our team have been hard at work on delivering a bunch of Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Changes to OlliOlli World in our latest 1.0.2 update.

[list]
[*] Fix for display of placeholder UI and level blocker in Ironcast Deck Factory levels in Sketchside under rare conditions.
[*] Fix for incorrect Button icon for Manuals on Switch.
[*] Fix for League Score incorrectly satisfying Local Hero score and preventing item unlock.
[*] Fixed rare issue causing UI elements and text to occasionally vanish on PS5.
[*] Fix for other players' pre-customisation outfits being shown in-game.
[*] Various Challenge adjustments to remove incorrect values preventing intended completion in some levels.
[*] Fix for isolated issue where a new player in Leagues could be given the wrong level and show a mismatched Replay.
[*] Fix for Friend Leaderboards not refreshing new scores without leaving the level.
[*] Fix for 'No checkpoint' markers being occasionally overwritten if revisiting a level.
[*] Fix for Mastery count being incremented by one extra point incorrectly.
[*] Fix for issue that could occasionally 'uncomplete' previously completed levels under specific conditions.
[*] Removal of smashable floor in Landfill Mountain.
[/list]

Thank you to our legendary QA team on OlliOlli World on continuing to crush bugs and help provide great quality of life updates to our community, and thank you to all in the community who continue to share with us bugs, feedback, incredible fan art and more to our team.

[h1][b]PEST CONTROL[/b][/h1]

If you’ve spotted a bug on your travels across Radlandia, we want to hear about it. While we love Cloverbrook’s wallride-toting bees, and even the giant mutant flies in Sketchside have their charms - we’re definitely not fans of gameplay bugs! 

[url=https://store.privatedivision.com/en/game/olliolli-world][img]https://i.imgur.com/kOzunFq.png[/img][/url]

You can send bug reports and general feedback to us directly through our social channels @OlliOlligame across [url=https://twitter.com/OlliOlligame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/OlliOlligame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/OlliOlligame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@OlliOlligame]TikTok[/url], and or directly to our Social & Community person at Roll7 (RobertRoll7#7426) via our [url=https://discord.gg/OlliOlliWorld]OlliOlli World Community Discord[/url]. Our amazing QA team are suiting up as we speak to deal with any reports that roll in - we can’t always respond to your feedback individually, but we do see it all and we really appreciate it.

[url=https://store.privatedivision.com/en/game/olliolli-world][img]https://i.imgur.com/tiiQY3R.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Gnarvana awaits! We can’t wait to see you there.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: OlliOlli World Community Update - Welcome to Radlandia
notes.notes:
[h1][b]WELCOME TO RADLANDIA![/b][/h1]

Hello skaters - it’s been just over two weeks since the launch of OlliOlli World on PC and consoles, and we’ve been blown away by the response from players across the globe. People have been sharing their gnarliest high scores, their wackiest character customisation choices, and of course their ongoing rivalry with a certain river-rafting bear…

If you’re already here - welcome to Radlandia! And if you’ve yet to take the trip, we wish you were here. [b]Look at all of this amazing fan art with us, and scroll to the bottom for a surprise announcement... 🏆 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315791/56326a9dae9ba7990d9e3a21959be29e95c08673.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]GNARVANA AWAITS - Announcing the Portal Postcode Challenge[/b][/h1]

Finally, we’re starting a new fortnightly community challenge on March 4th! [b]The Portal Postcode Challenge[/b] (which my boss tells me I am not allowed to refer to as the P.P. Challenge) will allow you to test your skills against players across the globe via our community.


Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] We will share a new Gnarvana Portal postcode across our social channels every two weeks.
[*] Access the Gnarvana Portal online game mode by completing all levels in Sunshine Valley, and then going to Gnarvana on your map and selecting portal mode. In future Portal Postcode Challenges, we will be venturing deeper into Gnarvana, which will require you to have explored further biomes across Radlandia and unlocked each biome’s path to Gnarvana.
[*] Input the Postcode shared across our social channels.
[*] You then have until the following Wednesday at 4PM GMT during each Portal Postcode Challenge week to brush up on your tricks, grabs, and grinds in order to achieve the highest score - only your best attempt counts, so don’t be afraid to test your limits and slam a few times (or a few hundred times).
[*] After the score counting closes, we’ll share the top winner of the leaderboard across our social channels, and the winner will be inducted into our Hall of Rad within the OlliOlli World Community Discord.
[/list]

[h3][b]Gnarvana awaits! We can’t wait to see you there.[/b][/h3]
